definitions.explanation: Any vehicle used for transportation, including cars, trains, bicycles, etc.
An attraction at an amusement park that people ride on.

notes:
{乗|の}り{物|もの} is a general term for anything you ride — vehicles, amusement park rides, etc. Composed of ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing).

USAGE:
1. Any vehicle or means of transportation: cars, trains, buses, bicycles, airplanes, boats
2. Amusement park rides: roller coasters, Ferris wheels, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{物|もの}{酔|よ}い→乗り物酔い：25234_norimonoyoi⟧: motion sickness
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗|の}り{物|もの}: public transportation
- {乗|の}り{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a vehicle/ride

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧: vehicle (technical/official term, especially for trains and rail cars)
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧: transportation system (more formal, refers to the system rather than individual vehicles)
